text:
I know. I know.

they are limited, they have needs

and concerns

that are different.


but I watch them and learn from them.

I like how little they know,

which is

so much.


they complain but they never

worry.

they walk with astonishing dignity.

they sleep with a direct simplicity that

human beings simply cannot

understand.


their eyes are more

beautiful than ours.

and they can sleep 20 hours

a day

without hesitation or

remorse.


when I feel

low in spirits

all I need is

to watch my cats

and

courage

returns to me.


I study these

creatures


they are my

teachers.

translation.title: My Cats
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves Bukowski's admiration for cats as calm, dignified teachers.
